summary: Describes how to safely replace the certificates that BGPsec routers use to sign routing announcements. The rollover must keep the distribution of new public keys in step with signed BGP updates so that verification keeps working. It also explains when and why a rollover is needed, so routing information is not lost.

eli5.summary: Changing the lock on a door only works if everyone gets the new key before the old one stops working. This explains how to swap router keys so nobody gets locked out.

questions: how to roll over router keys
